primaryReferences.fact: Apple directs consumers to installed xcresulttool command help for output format; test-details accepts testIdentifier or testIdentifierURL.
Parameterized tests execute independent argument combinations; qualified only-testing identifiers choose target/suite/function.

Primary implementation of the maintained result consumer enumerates actual Arguments children and takes their name/result under the qualified Test Case. This is corroborating parser source, not an Apple output-version guarantee.

implementedContract: Actual tests tree Test Case nodeIdentifier must resolve to the selected qualified method. Exactly two Arguments descendants must carry false and true (optionally labeled interrupt:) once each and Passed. Retries, repeats, unexpected inputs, missing/duplicate methods and skipped/failing descendants are rejected. Detailed expression/value nesting is preserved raw without inventing a schema. The detailed qualified identity/result and installed help declarations are independently bound.
unsupportedOrUnknownArgumentShape: Fail closed; preserve original raw tree/details and help for diagnosis. Never infer or suppress duplicate arguments from summary count.
